title: elma365-native-coverage@1
$comment: Native coverage contract for netbka/elma365#60 (Wiki PLAN-01 P4, MR-04): a capability catalog that states per component service/kind what elma365 can natively materialize, with evidence, and the per-release coverage declaration Wiki lib/native-coverage-adapter.mjs consumes. coverage.mjs validates documents against these $defs (strict: every object rejects unknown fields) and applies the semantic rules in docs/enterprise-development/native-coverage-and-receipts.md. Patterns use JavaScript RegExp syntax. Only the JSON Schema keyword subset of schema-subset.mjs is used. $defs/schemaRevision names this file's revision; the contract document publishes its sha256 (of these LF bytes).

schemaRevision.$comment: Revision of this schema file within contract version 1. 1.0 = first head of PR #103 (never merged or pinned). 1.1 = first published revision: evidence basis per capability, member, unit and declaration; changesDigest. Never used to validate a document; documents carry only {id, version}.

componentKey.$comment: Wiki componentIdentity profile 2 key: the JSON array text of [service, namespace, (kind,) code].

repoPath.$comment: Repository-relative POSIX path of committed evidence: no drive, UNC, leading slash, backslash, empty or dot segment.

capabilityStatus.$comment: proven-offline: repository tests on committed synthetic fixtures or committed exports prove it without a live Target. unsupported: a test or a policy rule shows it cannot be certified. unknown: no evidence either way. A live-proven status needs a later revision and a native receipt.

evidenceBasis.$comment: What a proven-offline claim was proven on. native-real-export: a committed export of a real ELMA solution (still offline, never native acceptance). synthetic-fixture: the committed synthetic fixture only; never native evidence. none: not proven.

name.$comment: Test name (kind test) or rule identifier (kind policy) that must occur in the file; null for a fixture or task record.

preserve.$comment: No-edit preservation: build, stage --verify and native pack reproduce every unpacked byte of the component.

edit.$comment: Whole-component materialization of a resolved change (E1 operations) under elma365-manifest-regeneration@1.

capabilityCatalog.$comment: Generated deterministically by generate-coverage.mjs from the evidence table in coverage.mjs and committed as coverage.capabilities.json. catalogDigest = sha256(canonical(catalog without catalogDigest)).

default.$comment: Any service/kind not listed in capabilities.

scopes.$comment: Request scopes (Wiki planReleaseScope request.kind). Only a whole Solution package can be declared; part expansion, application membership and full-server global-domain inventory are not established natively.

granularity.$comment: One import unit per Solution package (.e365); members are every captured component.

targetPreservation.$comment: Whether a native import retains unlisted Target objects is not established; no retain-unlisted policy is declared.

evidenceBasis.$comment: synthetic-fixture when the member's preservation or changed operation is proven on the synthetic fixture only. Wiki reads {solution, key, digest}; a consumer must not treat synthetic-fixture as native.

unsupportedMember.$comment: Wiki reads {solution, key}; service, kind, digest and reason are the native explanation. digest is null only for a removed component.

targetPrecondition.$comment: Pinned for later preflight, derived from an observed elma365-dependency-receipt@1 Target profile report on the same profile: empty-target when the Solution code is not installed, existing-target otherwise. No preservation policy or baseline is declared in v1, so Wiki blocks an existing Target (unproven-target-preservation).

status.$comment: supported exactly when unsupportedMembers is empty.

evidenceBasis.$comment: synthetic-fixture if any member or supported removal is synthetic-fixture; none without members or removals.

receipt.$comment: Native import receipts need an import worker (P6/P8); null in revision 1.0.

coverageDeclaration.$comment: The document Wiki adaptNativeCoverage admits: {contract, nativeRevision, adapter, evidenceRef, targetProfileDigest, captures, units, applications, parts, server}. catalogDigest, changesDigest, evidenceBasis, publicationReady and executionEnabled are native additions the consumer must check (changesDigest, evidenceBasis) or may ignore.

changesDigest.$comment: sha256(canonical(changes)) over the release changes this declaration was derived for: [{solution, key, op, digest}] (digest of the resulting component, null for remove), sorted by [solution, key]. A consumer recomputes it from its own request and rejects a mismatch.

evidenceBasis.$comment: synthetic-fixture if any unit is; none without any member.

applications.$comment: Application membership is not established natively in 1.0.

parts.$comment: Part-to-unit expansion is not established natively in 1.0.

server.$comment: Global-domain inventory and executable handlers are not established natively in 1.0.
